title: feat(nm2orichz): opposite-pair 1-in 2-out frame orientation at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Orientation convention #1 (opposite-pair frame): with M={m} singleton and O carrying some +e/-e, take e = positive unit of the smallest such axis, l = the remaining positive axis unit, Orient = sign det(m,e,+l). On opposite z-probes gives -1,-1,+1,-1 -> reverse HOLD, face fail. Recomputed exactly; and this sign FLIPS under proper cubic rotations of the same configuration.
